text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's almost my turn.
This line was so long,
but my
wait is almost over!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! One airline bento box,
please!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, ma'am,
but we're all sold
out of
those at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Say it's not so! My beloved airline
bento?
Sold out?! Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is devastated that she
couldn't
buy the bento box she'd been
looking forward to
eating.
